meta.title: DeFiMap: every position, explained
meta.description: DeFiMap rebuilds every liquidity position from on-chain history and splits its result into price, fees, rewards, gas and impermanent loss, across protocols and wallets, in one dashboard.
meta.ogDescription: Performance accounting for DeFi liquidity: PnL split into price, fees, rewards, gas and impermanent loss, per position, pool and protocol.
